**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-inducement covenant. Section 14.8 (Personnel) — the likely home for such a restriction per the planner hint — deals only with supervision/direction of each party's own personnel, IBM's right to assign its staff, and IBM's right to subcontract. Targeted searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", and "recruit" surfaced nothing restrictive (the only "employ" hits are definitional/indemnity references to employees).

Since our preferred position under NOSOLICIT is **no non-solicit on Customer at all**, the absence of any such covenant sits at the preferred position rather than the fallback, and there is nothing to narrow or delete.
